title: Win the inner field first
summary: Let contentment, humility, and remembrance make the next repetition believable. Let this stay near the next choice: hold onto this: conquer the mind before trying to conquer the world.
takeaway: Choose the practice that leaves the heart steadier, not louder.
lifeApplication: Choose one repeatable cue today and keep it without negotiation, even if it is small enough to feel unremarkable.

source.shortMeaning: Conquering the mind matters more than conquering the world around you.
source.lifeApplication: Return your attention from other people to the state of your own mind.
